name: Case of the Shifting Visage
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1.
To solve — There are fifteen or more cards in your graveyard. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
Solved — Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell, copy that spell. (The copy becomes a token.)
blocked_sentences: To solve — There are fifteen or more cards in your graveyard. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
Solved — Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell, copy that spell. (The copy becomes a token.)

needs.what: The Case mechanic (rule 719): a 'solved' designation on a Case permanent; a 'To solve — <condition>' line that compiles to the implicit triggered ability 'At the beginning of your end step, if this Case is not solved and <condition>, it becomes solved'; and 'Solved — <ability>' abilities that the permanent has only while it is solved (like a Class `level` gate), plus a condition/filter that reads whether a Case is solved
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Nothing in reference names solving: there is no solved designation, no ability key gating an ability on it (`level` and `threshold` are the closest gates but read Class level and counters), and approximating it with `set_flag` from an end_step trigger plus a `has_flag` condition on the cast trigger would leave the Solved ability always on the permanent and give the designation no rules identity (copy/blink/'solved Case' checks), so it is an approximation
